data.name: Catlite
data.detailed_description:
In this charming and bloody Roguelite, you Shoot your way through hordes of Mutant Rats, Defeat Bosses and Rescue cats to bolster the Feline Resistance! Crawl through sewers, cities and laboratories. Unlock weapons, upgrades and perks to help the cats survive in this dystopian world.

PLAY AS CATLITE

You play as Catlite, a cute little machine of destruction built to fight off hordes of Rats and Rescue stray Cats amidst the chaos.

THE GREAT RODENT OUTBURST

The world was suddenly consumed by chaotic violence as countless rats emerged everywhere, destroying or taking over everything!

THE FELINE RESISTANCE

A group of brave cats managed to fight through the chaos to create escape routes that ended up saving many lives. They ran to areas away from the main city, and the rats were not organized enough to notice. They survived!
Those became the Feline Resistance!

Every room has some kind of Reward! Catlite adapts and evolves by acquiring Boosts that last through the mission, enhancing combat capabilities!

By the end of every mission you will find and Rescue a Cat that comes back with you to the Feline Resistance Camp! That is, if you succeed...

GAME FEATURES

Game Runs

  • They start by leaving the Resistance Camp to go out in missions where Catlite travels through many different levels fighting enemies and collecting rewards that enhance the Calite’s abilities. The levels and enemies are characteristic of each Zone. A typical run will last about 30 minutes and ends when either Catlite is destroyed or finds a stray cat to rescue.

Boosts

  • Earn Boosts rewards are through your run! They come as a choice between 3 boost options to enhance one of Catlite’s abilities or his weapon. Since they come in random options to choose from, they combine both luck and strategy.

Zones

  • The runs progress through different Zones, first the Sewers, then the City and finally the Rat Labs. Each zone presents different challenges with their own sets of enemies and levels.

Upgrades & Perks

  • making it permanently more powerful and allowing to progress further through the runs.

  • Besides upgrades, you may also unlock powerful Perks, allowing Dr. Cattus to tune Catlite to have specific advantages on the run. Only a limited number of Perks may be used simultaneously and combining them can strategically improve your play style.

Weapons

  • You start with one weapon and unlock more as you progress through the game.

  • Choose which weapon you will bring to your next run before you leave the Camp.

  • Weapons add variety to your fighting style and will synergize differently with your Upgrades, Perks and Boosts. Make your strategy and maximize your destructive potential.

Gadgets

  • Gadgets are secondary weapons or utility items you can equip. They may allow you to lay mines, throw a grenade, activate a shield, boost your speed or even modify your dash ability.

  • Some Gadgets can be picked in the Camp, in preparation for the next run, but many Gadgets can only be found as level rewards in your run.

Enemies

  • The filthy rats! You will find a variety of them everywhere you go. They come in many different shapes and each fight in their own way. In the Sewers you may face religious fanatics, acolytes to their radioactive god. In the Cities they may carry more advanced weapons, adapted to their mutated shapes but it is in their labs that you will face the true horrors, creatures mutated beyond recognition, masterpieces of their mad genetic scientists.

Bosses

  • At the end of every Zone, there is a powerful Boss. They will do whatever it takes to prevent Catlite from progressing to the next area. Be ready for a hard fight! Learn their movements, their fighting styles and adapt to overcome them. Those are extremely tough fool-hardy rats that will never give up their turf and will keep coming back even after being defeated.

Dynamic Difficulty

  • The game difficulty will increase with each successful run. And on every run, each Zone is also more difficult than the previous. Choosing the best combination of Boosts, Upgrades and Perks is key to overcoming this increasing difficulty.

  • As you progress through the game and unlock more powerful Weapons, Gadgets, Upgrades and Perks, the enemies will also learn new tricks, adding more dynamics to your runs.

Store Level & Currencies

  • Throughout the runs you will collect rat teeth, which can be used in Store Levels. The merchant will accept teeth like coins and exchange them for powerful boosts.

  • On many levels you will have a chance to choose between going to the Store Level or pursuing a different reward.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1080
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel i7 or similar
